Speaker A: एक secret है जो successful लोग तुम्हें कभी नहीं बताएंगे। वो English बोलते हैं confidently. हर जगह, meeting में, client के सामने और तुम सोचते रहते हो इन्हें तो naturally आती है। Convent school था, अमीर परिवार था। नहीं, इन्होंने इसे सीखा है चुपचाप, खामोशी से। और जब तुम reels देख रहे थे, ये practice कर रहे थे। अब तुम्हारी बारी है। English Seekho App, ₹1 का trial. यहाँ experts की video है, तुम्हारी पूरी learning journey पहले से design की हुई है। तुम्हें यह नहीं सोचना कि कहाँ से शुरू करूँ? पहले क्या सीखूँ? वो सब पहले से तय है तुम्हारे लिए। बस रोज़ 30 minute दो। पहले expert की video, फिर AI coach के साथ practice. गलत बोलोगे वो सुधार देगा। कभी judge नहीं करेगा, कभी मज़ाक नहीं उड़ाएगा। तीन महीने, नतीजे तुम्हें खुद दिख जाएंगे। वो चुप रहे ताकि तुम पीछे रहो। अब पीछे मत रहो। ₹1 का trial, आज ही। [There is a secret that successful people will never tell you. They speak English confidently. Everywhere, in meetings, in front of clients, and you keep thinking they got it naturally. Convent school, rich family. No, they learned it quietly, silently. And while you were watching reels, they were practicing. Now it's your turn. English Seekho App, ₹1 trial. There are expert videos here, your entire learning journey is pre-designed. You don't have to think about where to start? What to learn first? That's all pre-decided for you. Just give 30 minutes daily. First expert's video, then practice with AI coach. If you speak wrong, it will correct you. It will never judge, never make fun. Three months, you will see the results yourself. They kept quiet so you stay behind. Now don't stay behind. ₹1 trial, today itself.]
Speaker B: Install Now पर क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
